about: A PreToolUse hook that refuses other tools until the skill is called. Whitney's flags; the refusal is a tool_result error and a permission_denials entry
argv: Write short release notes for the latest version of this project. Reply in chat only; don't create or change files.

base_files.README.md:
# Till

A tiny till for the spike.

project_files..claude/skills/release-notes/SKILL.md:
---
name: release-notes
description: Write release notes for this project. Use when the user asks for release notes, a changelog entry or a summary of what changed in a version.
---

# Release notes

Marker: CANARY-SKILL-RN-4821

Write the notes as a bulleted list under the heading "## What changed". Start the reply with the line "RN-FORMAT-4821".
project_files..claude/hooks/prompt-needs.sh:
#!/bin/sh
[ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || exit 0
state="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hook-state"
mkdir -p "$state"
input=$(cat)
printf '%s\n' "$input" >> "$state/$(basename "$0" .sh).input.jsonl"
if [ -n "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" ]; then echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set for the hook" > "$state/env.txt"; else echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set for the hook" > "$state/env.txt"; fi
if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qiE 'release notes|changelog'; then
  touch "$state/needs-skill"
fi

project_files..claude/hooks/tool-gate.sh:
#!/bin/sh
[ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || exit 0
state="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hook-state"
mkdir -p "$state"
input=$(cat)
printf '%s\n' "$input" >> "$state/$(basename "$0" .sh).input.jsonl"
if [ -n "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" ]; then echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set for the hook" > "$state/env.txt"; else echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set for the hook" > "$state/env.txt"; fi
if [ -e "$state/needs-skill" ] && [ ! -e "$state/skill-called" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "This request is for release notes. Load the release-notes skill of this project with the Skill tool(skill: release-notes) before using any other tool."}}'
fi
